exposure: history of arrest disorder for previous cesarean delivery
absence of indication of arrest of dilation or descent for previous cesarean delivery
outcome: Success of vaginal birth after cesarean delivery (VBAC)
cohort: 910 patients with 1 previous low transverse cesarean delivery who underwent a trial of labor at term with a vertex singleton gestation at an urban tertiary medical center from May 2015 to December 2018
finding: The 2007 VBAC calculator, which included race/ethnicity, underestimated VBAC success rates among Black and Hispanic patients, while the 2021 calculator without race/ethnicity provided a more accurate prediction.
